html:
My PhD advisor, Michael Vorländer.


This photo is about ten years old and is used all over the web. He’s now nearly 60, still going strong and as dashing as ever.

As the resident heartthrob of the acoustics world, he reportedly has a whole following of female grad students and professors in the US. Like in this photo.



Professor Vorländer has served as president of the ICA (International Commission for Acoustics), president of the EAA (European Acoustics Association) and president of DAGA (the German Acoustical Society), as dean of the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Information Technology at RWTH Aachen University and as spokesperson for the RWTH professors, and as an editorial board member of JASA, Applied Acoustics, Acta Acustica and other acoustics journals. He has won awards from acoustical societies in many countries and published Auralization, the first book on virtual acoustics. The list of titles goes on and on.


Of everyone who has dealt with him, I’ve never heard a single one say anything negative about him (apart from his free-range style of supervision). People are won over first by his charisma and the grace of a great scholar, and then by the looks on top of that, and so he has gained countless fans. He always puts his students first and never pushes them (which has its pros and cons…). Throughout my PhD, I always felt I had a solid backstop in him, with his steady gaze of support and his charming smile. One thing tells you all you need to know about him as a person:

Whenever he travels, to any city in any country, if he has students there and they know he’s coming, every one of them goes all out to host him. That’s why he and his students have stayed on such good terms all these years. He’s good friends with many people in acoustics, such as Jian Kang at UCL, one of the leading Chinese acousticians.


Of the countless professors I’ve met over the years, in China and abroad, Vorländer is my favorite and the one I admire most, bar none.


For more on acoustics (popular science, curiosities, little-known facts, industrial applications, case studies and where the field is heading), follow my WeChat Official Account, Ziyu Acoustics.
